Burn Test Log

Wick choice is found by testing, not by calculation. Your wax, fragrance load, dye and jar width all affect which wick suits a candle. Record what you burn.

What to record. Melt pool width at each hour, how the flame behaves, and any soot on the glass or mushrooming on the wick tip. A wick that is too small tunnels; one that is too large soots and overheats the jar. Follow your wick supplier's own guidance on burn-test length and conditions.

Hour columns: write the width of the melted wax across the top of the candle at that hour. Verdict: keep, size up, or size down.
